thread:
julie-support: Zenova (private deployment) opened a security escalation — they see a burst of KMS Decrypts tied to a service account and an unexpected change to a k8s RoleBinding. Asking for immediate log pull and containment. :rotating_light:

samir-sec: Copy. Can you paste the snippet they sent?

julie-support: They included this audit excerpt and said it was NOT an expected maintenance window:
```
2026-03-19T19:12:03Z KMS Decrypt request=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/prod/cryptoKeys/tenant-key principal=svc-account-zenova-01 src_ip=34.122.11.9 result=OK
2026-03-19T19:12:07Z k8s.audit RoleBinding patch user="svc-account-zenova-01" changed: subjects+[system:serviceaccount:default:svc-account-zenova-01]
```

matt-infra: @chris-sre @anya-eng can you check k8s audit logs + kube-apiserver for that timeframe? Also need cloud KMS audit logs for decrypts for that key.

chris-sre: Running queries now. Posting results in ~5m.

security-bot: Automated alert: unusual KMS decrypt rate detected for key tenant-key (spike: 42 decrypts in 2m). Alert ID sec-20260319-0912

anya-eng: Quick question — do we have tenant network egress restrictions in this private layout? If calls are coming from public IPs we need to verify VPC NAT rules and any customer-managed proxies.

matt-infra: Zenova's cluster is in their VPC with a NAT gateway. We should check bastion logs and any outside egress flows. Also rotate the service account key and block it from API server until we validate.

samir-sec: Agreed. Containment steps (proposed):
1) Revoke service account tokens for svc-account-zenova-01 (temp).
2) Add deny rule in RBAC for that subject on critical namespaces.
3) Snapshot and export all k8s audit logs + KMS audit entries for 19:00-20:00 UTC.
4) Preserve container logs and node metadata.

julie-support: I've told the customer we'll perform a non-destructive snapshot and rotate keys. They asked us not to remove resources without notice.

chris-sre: k8s audit query result (abridged):
```
2026-03-19T19:11:58Z user="system:serviceaccount:default:svc-account-zenova-01" verb=patch resource=rolebindings namespace=prod name=prod-readers
2026-03-19T19:12:07Z user="system:serviceaccount:default:svc-account-zenova-01" verb=patch resource=rolebindings namespace=prod name=prod-admins
```
IP observed on node logs: 10.128.5.22 (pod IP) initiating requests, but outbound NAT mapped to 34.122.11.9

matt-infra: KMS audit shows decrypts from the same principal and same src_ip. No other known Redwood service used that principal.

anya-eng: Two possible hypotheses: compromised service account token (exfil), or a pod image with embedded creds. We should check recent image pulls and CI/CD deploy logs for that service account.

samir-sec: Action plan and owner list:
- chris-sre: capture full audit bundle + node disk snapshot (ETA 25m)
- matt-infra: rotate KMS key credentials and create temporary key ACL denying svc-account-zenova-01 (ETA 15m)
- anya-eng: scan recent container registry activity for images run by that SA and fetch CI/CD deploy audit (ETA 30m)
- julie-support: coordinate customer comms and obtain written permission for snapshots

julie-support: Customer okayed snapshots and asks for timeline for next update.

chris-sre: Collected audit bundle and uploaded to secured bucket (preserved). Sample evidence: 42 decrypts, 7 rolebinding patches, 3 distinct pod restarts.

matt-infra: I applied a temporary KMS IAM deny for svc-account-zenova-01 and revoked its current tokens (rotated creds). I also blocked outbound NAT for the node pool associated with those pods as a precaution.

anya-eng: Found a recent CI run that injected a secret to the image build step on 2026-03-19T18:58 which referenced svc-account-zenova-01. We're pulling the pipeline logs now.

samir-sec: Good. Preserve pipeline logs, registry manifests, and any access tokens. We'll treat this as a confirmed compromise until we can show otherwise.

julie-support: Notified customer of containment actions and asked if they want us to create a temporary dedicated read-only mirror while they triage. They requested a conference bridge at 20:15 UTC.

security-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-20260319-zenova-01 (severity: high). Next steps: postmortem owner assignment pending.

chris-sre: Leaving notes — evidence preserved, snapshot checksums saved. Will hand off to sec for deeper Triage.

samir-sec: We'll run compromise scope checks (credential abuse patterns, lateral movement, other tenants) and will coordinate a detailed timeline. Please avoid deleting any resources until we complete forensic image pulls.

julie-support: Thanks team. I'll post the bridge link and update Zenova with timelines. Will update thread after the bridge. :white_check_mark:
